title: Hunter hotfix: Trueshot Aura and Aspect of the Hawk

lines.title: Trueshot Aura and Aspect of the Hawk give about half as much at their lower ranks, so a level 60 hunter's best are Trueshot Aura rank 5 (+50 ranged attack power) and Aspect of the Hawk rank 6 (+55)
lines.note: A server hotfix on the launch realms, not in the development notes: Trueshot Aura 15 / 22 / 30 / 40 / 50, Aspect of the Hawk 15 / 22 / 30 / 38 / 47 / 55.

lines.title: High Order Frostfire and Arcane: rotations built around Wind Blessed
Troll Elemental: Berserking right after Elemental Mastery
Night Elf Fury: Elune's Light at the pull
Gnome warlocks: Eureka! timed so its 8 sec cover the spells it boosts

title: Blood Fury, Berserking and Touch of the Grave

lines.title: Orc: Blood Fury cooldown 2 min (was 3 min)
Troll: Berserking lasts 15 sec (was 10 sec)
Undead: Touch of the Grave can drain every 15 sec (was 25 sec)
Presets moved to their new best race
lines.note: Shadow to Undead; Combat Daggers, Seal Fate Daggers, Combat Swords and Subtlety to Undead; Enhancement to Orc; Demonology and Destruction to Orc; Destruction Fire to Undead.

lines.title: Each race now plays its own rotation where it beats the preset's
lines.note: High Order and Windshaper Balance, Fire and Frostfire; Troll, Orc and Undead Frostfire; Gnome rogues with Eureka!; Holy Fire Smite for Dwarf, Gnome, Human, Night Elf and Troll.

lines.title: Dwarves move their hit over the cap into other stats
lines.note: On the 14 presets where it gains: hunters, Retribution, Shadow, Elemental, Arms and 2H Fury.

lines.title: Presets moved to their best race
lines.note: Beast Mastery, Marksmanship and Survival to Orc; Lone Wolf and Balance to Night Elf; Balance Wrath to Windshaper; Arcane to Gnome; every Retribution preset to Undead; dagger rogues to Gnome; Mutilate and Seal Fate Swords to Undead; Enhancement to Windshaper; Arms to Undead.

lines.title: Retribution Shock (deep Holy): retuned rotation
Retribution Shock vs Undead and its Crusader duty: Light's Vigil timing retuned
Human: Ruthless gives 1% crit (was 2%), The Human Spirit 10% Spirit (was 5%)
Dwarf: Earth Fury (2% crit damage) is gone, the new Artisan's Precision gives 1% hit with attacks and spells
Tauren: Endurance gives 5% health only, with no 2% crit damage
Orc: Savage (1% crit) is gone, Command is back: Hunter and Warlock pets deal 5% more damage
Skyborne: Wind Blessed gives 2% haste (was 3%), Read Leyline 50% more Spirit regen for 15 sec (was 100% for 30 sec)
Warlock: Spellstone adds Shadow damage only, no longer Fire
Mage: Arcane Missiles no longer procs Missile Barrage
lines.note: Client 70630's talent text no longer lists Arcane Missiles among the spells that trigger it.

lines.title: Mage: Arcane Instability and Arcane Power no longer raise Ignite's ticks
lines.note: No preset takes Ignite with either talent, so no preset's DPS moves.
